title: Hearing on pregnancy and birth health outcomes for immigrants
summary: The Council will examine pregnancy- and birth-related health outcomes among immigrant New Yorkers, who make up about 38 percent of the city's population. Officials from the Mayor's Office of Immigrant Affairs and the Health Department, along with advocates, will testify on disparities in prenatal care, maternal mortality and access to health coverage, including risks from recent federal Medicaid and Essential Plan changes. The Committees will also hear a bill barring city resources from being used to enforce restrictions on reproductive care.
